audit_member_text: Range contract is unchecked locally: BB2 and CC2 are dimensioned NumFreq at L78, but values from loop_index are assigned to KF/kf at L169 and L177 and then index BB2, CC2, OMGN2D, Cm, and Sm at L170-L179. No 1<=loop_index<=NumFreq check appears in this subroutine, so an invalid producer-side loop_index can exceed these arrays.

Preprocessor/interface mismatch: VESSEL_MODULE is imported only under VESSEL at L58-L60, while VisVessel_2D and CdVessel_2D are referenced under DEEP_DRAFT_VESSEL at L200-L202, L269-L272, and L327-L330. This file contains no requirement that DEEP_DRAFT_VESSEL imply VESSEL; a build defining the former alone lacks the guarded module import for those names.

Potential stencil range overrun relies on an external ghost-cell invariant: loops use Jbeg:Jend and Ibeg:Iend at L230-L231, while the PQ branch accesses P(I+2,J) and Q(I,J+2) at L403 and L415 and other paths use I/J +/-1. This file comments that ghost cells are needed at L193/L214 but performs no local bounds check.

Singularity preconditions are not checked in this subroutine: ramp/phase expressions divide by Time_ramp*Tperiod at L110, Time_ramp at L120/L151/L167, Time_ramp*PeakPeriod at L136, and WAVE_COMP(kf,1) at L138. Zero values would make these expressions undefined; whether input validation elsewhere excludes zero is not established by this file.
